translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Le' ngoo lo na'le bish' ljwellchoka' nonḻilall' Crístona', ḻekzka' nad' nḻan' ka daa nḻanle, na' ble'teid' ka wxak'zi' Crístona', na' len' chidoḻaa ikaa balaaṉ xenna' kat' yilee. Daan, chat'yoid' le':

Gap wwiale beṉ'ka' ba nonḻilall' Chioza', beṉ'ka' ba none' lall' na'le. Ḻi gonan ḻega beṉ' chibayi gon ka chazlall' Chioza'. Na' aga gonyaadiazlen, ni bi gonle lez gaxjle dii xen, san ḻi gonan do yic̱hj do lall'le.
Na' bi gonzle ka chṉabia'tegal lao beṉ'ka' nak lall' na'le, san chiyaḻ' wli'le chonle wen lawe'ka'.
Na' kat' yila' Jesucrístona', beena' chṉabia' yog'ḻoḻ beṉ'ka' chap chwia beṉ'ka' nonḻilall'gake'ne', na' goṉe' le' to balaaṉ xen daa biga te c̱heyin.
Na' ḻekzka' le' bi' xkwid', wḻex̱j yic̱hjle lao beṉ' golka'. Na' yog'ḻoḻ-le chiyaḻ' wḻex̱j yic̱hjle lao ljwell-le ganga, na' gakle beṉ' gax̱jlall', ḻa':

content.text: Chioza' bi chle'shiile' beṉ'ka' chep cha'lall',

content: Ḻi gak beṉ' gax̱jlall' lao Chioza', beena' nap yeḻ' wak choo yeḻ' wak xen, kwenc̱he kwee le' balaaṉ kat' illin llana'.
Ḻi gon lall' na' Chioza' yog'ḻoḻ dii chak c̱hele, ḻa' ḻe' zie' wṉeyi c̱hele.
Ḻi gakto beṉ' nyeeṉ nyeeniyi na' ḻi se kwas. Ḻa' dii x̱iwaa daa chakzi' chakzbani cho' chdan ka to bell zṉia, ba chbiḻ chdon, na' chyiljan no wlliayi'n.
Ḻi soatip ḻi soashosh gonḻilall'le Crístona' na' bi we'zle latj c̱he dii x̱iwaa, ḻa' ṉezkzile' doxenzə yell-lioni yog'ḻoḻ beṉ'ka' nakcho txen ba chle'gakile' yeḻ' zak'zi'ka' ka diika' chen chle'ile.

Na' ka ba biyoll wdele yeḻ' zak'zi'ka' shloll, Chioza', beena' nap yeḻ' chiyesh'lall' xen, yiyone' le' ka chazlallee na' gone' ka gakchachle na' yizoatip yizoashoshe' le'. Ḻa' ḻekzen' gox wṉabe' cho' kwenc̱he yidoḻ'cho balaaṉ xen c̱he'na' daa bi te c̱heyin daa nakcho Crístona' txen.
Ḻen' chidoḻee sho'e balaaṉna' na' iṉabi'e zejḻi kaṉi. Kan' nakan.

Beṉ' bish'cho Silvánoni, beeni ṉezid' zoatip zoashoshe' nonḻilallee Crístona', goklene' nad' bzej' le' to c̱hop cho'a dill' kwenc̱he wtip' lall'le. Na' dga nia' le' chli'n dii ḻicha chaki Chioza' cho'. Ḻi soatip ḻi soashosh lo yeḻ' chaki c̱he'na'.
Beṉ'ki nonḻilall' Crístona' yell Babilóniani, beṉ'ki ba gox wṉab Chioza' ka gox wṉabe' le', na' ḻekzka' Márconi, bi'ni nak ka dowalj bi' c̱ha', chwapgake' le' chiox.
Ḻi wwap chiox ljwell-le ḻega beṉ' chaki ljwellin. Soashgale mbalaz yog'ḻoḻ-le le' nakle Crístona' txen.
